description.zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值：**1**。
description.en: The page number in a paged query. Default value: **1**.

description.zh:
数据资产表中列数据所属的资产实例ID。

> 根据数据资产表中列数据所属的资产实例的ID，查询数据安全中心连接授权的数据资产表中列的数据，资产实例ID可调用[DescribeInstances](~~141708~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the asset instance to which the column data in the data asset table belongs.

> Queries column data in data asset tables that are connected to and authorized by Data Security Center based on the asset instance ID. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~141708~~) operation to obtain the instance ID.

description.zh: 数据资产表中列数据所属的资产实例名称。
description.en: The name of the asset instance to which the column data in the data asset table belongs.

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh_cn**。
取值：

- **zh_cn**：中文（简体）
- **en_us**：英文（美国）
description.en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh_cn**.

Valid values:

- **zh_cn**: Chinese (Simplified).
- **en_us**: English (US).

description.zh:
搜索的关键词，支持模糊匹配。

例如，输入**test**，会搜索出搜索项中包含**test**的全部数据信息。
description.en:
The keyword to search for. Fuzzy match is supported.

For example, if you enter **test**, all data entries that contain **test** in the search fields are returned.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置列表中每页显示的数据资产实例的最大条数。默认值：**10**。
description.en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **10**.

description.zh: 数据资产表中列数据所属产品名称。取值：**MaxCompute、OSS、ADS、OTS、RDS**等。
description.en: The name of the product to which the column data in the data asset table belongs. Valid values: **MaxCompute, OSS, ADS, OTS, RDS**, and others.

The risk level ID of the sensitive data detection rule. Valid values:
- **1**: N/A.
- **2**: S1.
- **3**: S2.
- **4**: S3.
- **5**: S4.

description.zh:
资产表中列数据命中的敏感数据识别规则的唯一标识ID。

> 根据资产表中列数据命中的敏感数据识别规则的ID，查询数据安全中心连接授权的数据资产表中列的数据，敏感数据识别规则ID可调用[DescribeRules](~~141389~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The unique ID of the sensitive data detection rule that the column data matches.

> Queries column data in data asset tables that are connected to and authorized by Data Security Center based on the ID of the sensitive data detection rule that the column data matches. You can call the [DescribeRules](~~141389~~) operation to obtain the rule ID.

description.zh: 数据资产表中列数据命中的敏感数据识别规则名称。
description.en: The name of the sensitive data detection rule that the column data in the data asset table matches.

description.zh:
敏感等级名。取值：
- **N/A**：未识别到敏感数据。
- **S1**：1级敏感数据。
- **S2**：2级敏感数据。
- **S3**：3级敏感数据。
- **S4**：4级敏感数据。
description.en:
The sensitivity level name. Valid values:
- **N/A**: no sensitive data detected.
- **S1**: Level 1 sensitive data.
- **S2**: Level 2 sensitive data.
- **S3**: Level 3 sensitive data.
- **S4**: Level 4 sensitive data.

description.zh:
MaxCompute、RDS等资产表中的列所属的资产表唯一标识ID。

> 根据资产表的ID查询数据安全中心连接授权的数据资产表中列的数据，资产表ID可调用[DescribeTables](~~141709~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The unique ID of the data asset table to which the columns belong in MaxCompute, ApsaraDB RDS, or other data assets.

> Queries column data in data asset tables that are connected to and authorized by Data Security Center based on the table ID. You can call the [DescribeTables](~~141709~~) operation to obtain the table ID.
The name of the data asset table.

title.zh: 查询数据资产表中列的数据V2
title.en: Query column data in data asset tables V2

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sddp describe-columns-v2 --lang zh_cn --name test --table-id 11132334 --rule-id 11122200 --product-code MaxCompute --instance-id 1 --instance-name rm-bp17t1htja573l5i80000 --table-name it_table --rule-name name --sens-level-name S2 --page-size 10 --current-page 1 --risk-level-id 2 --engine-type MySQL --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sddp DescribeColumnsV2 --region cn-hangzhou --TableId 11132334 --PageSize 10 --ProductCode MaxCompute --InstanceId 1 --RuleId 11122200 --Lang zh_cn --RiskLevelId 2 --Name test --InstanceName 'rm-bp17t1htja573l5i80000' --TableName it_table --SensLevelName S2 --CurrentPage 1 --EngineType MySQL --RuleName name
